name: Undervoltage-release holding interface
summary: Identifies the control-energy condition that holds the documented undervoltage release in its normal state.
description: Identifies the control-energy condition that holds the documented undervoltage release in its normal state. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Release control voltage” at the input and “Release holding state” at the output. Its operation differs from an energized shunt-trip command.
